title: Product contract & architecture decisions
description: Freeze the reviewable personal-workspace contract and resolve alpha-blocking architecture choices.
exit_criteria: All alpha-blocking ADRs are accepted; v0 Space, Session, context-pack, event and runtime contracts are frozen.

title: Local shell & Space foundations
description: Ship the local application skeleton with Projects and Areas as real context/resource boundaries plus explicit Resource relationships.
exit_criteria: First-run shell opens offline with HUE-owned Spaces/Sessions, shadcn-compatible HUE primitives, persistent state and honest empty/error/recovery screens.

title: Sessions, context packs & portable knowledge
description: Provide isolated typed Sessions, human-readable context packs, layered memory, source ownership and a useful second-brain substrate.
exit_criteria: Two fixture Spaces cannot leak context; context packs remain useful as files; Session summaries and source projections preserve provenance.

title: Durable tasks, runs & visible execution
description: Turn outcomes into resumable tasks with semantic events, one trustworthy worker path and durable local attention.
exit_criteria: A real Space-bound task survives restart, returns evidence-backed artifacts and creates exactly one policy-correct local completion notification.

title: Worker catalog & capability routing
description: Choose temporary specialists, models, providers, tools and runtimes by transparent policy.
exit_criteria: Fixture tasks route correctly under privacy, budget, health and user-override constraints.

title: OpenCode-first coding workspace & artifact review
description: Deliver the first primary software execution path through OpenCode with worktrees, tests, diffs, review and handoff.
exit_criteria: A multi-file issue is completed through the OpenCode adapter, verified and presented for user-approved merge/PR handoff.

title: Permissions, browser & computer use
description: Operate web/native applications through scoped grants, approvals and verified side effects.
exit_criteria: A native-app workflow completes visibly and stops at every consequential boundary.

title: Replaceable runtime adapters & open ecosystem
description: Prove HUE can normalize heterogeneous agents, source systems and tools behind stable contracts.
exit_criteria: Two heterogeneous runtimes pass conformance with normalized events, scoped context and truthful recovery.

title: Alpha hardening & portable release
description: Package a secure, accessible, recoverable local alpha with optional privacy-preserving phone attention.
exit_criteria: Security, quality, backup and operations gates pass, and one authorized phone channel delivers a redacted task outcome with a secure deep link.
